errors.text_span: Етикетите са разположени на равни интервали
errors.evidence: The labels on the X-axis are at 0, 3, 5, and 10. The intervals between them are 3, 2, and 5, which are not equal.
The data series for LLaMA 8B does not have a data point at 10 shots. Its last recorded point is at 5 shots, with a value of approximately 78.0%.

errors.text_span: и се поддържа на този ниво при 10 shots
errors.evidence: For the Qwen2 series, the value at 5 shots is approximately 77.9% and at 10 shots it is approximately 77.7%. Stating that the level is 'maintained' is an over-generalization of the slight decrease.
The data point for the ChatGPT line at 3 shots is exactly on the 84.5% grid line, not 'около 84.3%' (around 84.3%).

errors.text_span: след което остава почти стабилна до 10 shots
errors.evidence: The data series for ChatGPT ends at 3 shots. There are no data points at 5 or 10 shots, so describing its behavior up to 10 shots is a hallucination.
The description states the x-axis has intervals of 3, but the tick marks are at 0, 3, 5, and 10, which are not regular intervals.
The description incorrectly identifies the markers for the LLaMA 8B series as crosses ('Kreuzmarkierungen') when they are circles.

errors.text_span: und steigt leicht auf etwa 78,2 % bei 10 Shots
errors.evidence: The description provides an endpoint for the LLaMA 8B line at 10 shots, but this data series has no data point at 10 shots; its final point is at 5 shots.

errors.text_span: fällt leicht auf etwa 78,1 % bei 3 Shots
errors.evidence: The description states the value for Qwen2 at 3 shots is approximately 78.1%, but the plot shows it to be approximately 78.4%.

errors.text_span: bleibt bei 5 Shots auf diesem Niveau
errors.evidence: The description claims the Qwen2 value remains at the same level from 3 shots to 5 shots. However, the plot shows a noticeable decrease from approximately 78.4% at 3 shots to 77.9% at 5 shots.

errors.text_span: und bleibt bei 10 Shots auf diesem Niveau
errors.evidence: The description claims the ChatGPT line continues to 10 shots, but the data series on the plot ends at 3 shots.
